channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City warns of possible rise in respiratory infections after Tet
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City health authorities said respiratory infectious diseases could increase following the Lunar New Year holiday, although dengue fever and hand, foot and mouth disease cases declined during the holiday period.

item.title: Google rolls out Nano Banana 2 after viral success of AI image generation tool
item.description: Google on Thursday unveiled a successor to its viral Nano Banana image generation model, touting faster performance as the search-engine behemoth pushes to attract more users to its AI tools.

item.title: U.S. temporary 10% tariff policy sparks fresh optimism among Vietnamese exporters
item.description: Vietnamese exporters are cautiously optimistic after the United States introduced a temporary universal tariff of 10 percent on imports for a 150-day period, believing the move could open up new opportunities to secure orders from one of Vietnam’s most important export markets.

item.title: English giants dominate line-up for Champions League last-16 draw
item.description: PARIS (FRANCE) -- The draw for the latter stages of this season's Champions League takes place on Friday with Newcastle United's midweek victory against Qarabag meaning an unprecedented six English sides will feature in the last 16.

item.title: Vietnam’s Khanh Hoa deports Kazakh man wanted on Interpol red notice
item.description: Authorities in Khanh Hoa Province, south-central Vietnam have deported a 49-year-old Kazakh national wanted internationally under an Interpol Red Notice, police confirmed on Thursday.

item.title: Vietnam’s Chinese chess master Lai Ly Huynh beats Guo Fengda, stays unbeaten at Wuyang Cup
item.description: Vietnam’s Lai Ly Huynh defeated China’s Guo Fengda in Group B of the Wuyang Cup on Thursday, remaining unbeaten after four rounds of the invitational Chinese chess tournament.

item.title: Vietnam women’s cycling races earn UCI 2.2 status for first time
item.description: Two women’s cycling races in Vietnam have been included in the International Cycling Union (UCI) calendar as Class 2.2 events for the first time, marking a milestone for the country’s women’s cycling scene.

item.title: Vietnam’s Khanh Hoa tightens border controls to prevent Nipah virus entry
item.description: Authorities in Khanh Hoa Province, home to the famed beach destination of Nha Trang in south-central Vietnam, have stepped up health screening at airports and seaports to guard against the possible entry of the Nipah virus, a rare but highly lethal pathogen.

item.title: Japan Vietnam Festival back in Ho Chi Minh City on largest-ever scale
item.description: The 11th Japan Vietnam Festival in Ho Chi Minh City will take place on the weekend under the theme of ‘Holding Hands Together – Children – Earth – Future.’

item.title: AI boom will be no free pass for debt-laden major economies
item.description: An AI productivity boom, if it materialises, may help buy major economies more time to clean up their strained public finances, economists say, although it won't do the heavy lifting.
